purpose: On label add/remove, run OpenSpec phase-progression label sync through handle-issue-labeled.cjs.

jobs.summary: Checkout, setup Node, npm ci, run handle-issue-labeled.cjs with --issue, --label, --dry-run, --verbose; echo results.

failure_points.issue: handle-issue-labeled.cjs only has module.exports and parses no arguments, so `node handle-issue-labeled.cjs --issue=...` loads and exits without doing anything.
PR events pass github.event.issue.number, which is empty for pull_request payloads.
`github.event.label.name` is interpolated directly into the shell; label names with spaces or metacharacters break the command or inject.
workflow_dispatch has no issue input, so manual runs pass an empty --issue.
Fires on every labeled/unlabeled event (the #3531 event-storm pattern).
The phase state machine uses openspec:specification-pending, which is not in labels.yml.
Spec 008 renames openspec:* to spec:* (FR-011) and replaces OpenSpec with Spec Kit (FR-013), so the workflow's subject is being retired.
